# George Panev

> Student web developer in Sofia, Bulgaria, seeking a software development internship.

## Projects

- [Koren demo](https://panevx.github.io/Koren/) and [source code](https://github.com/panevx/Koren): Bilingual learning games about Bulgaria for children abroad. In development since November 2026. George plans to participate in Junior Achievement again.
- [AnimalSync browser demo](https://project-animalsync.2su.bg/): George built the HTML demo using sample data for the team's smart pet collar concept. The project qualified for the Junior Achievement National Finals in 2025.
- [Personal portfolio](https://georgepanev.com/) and [source code](https://github.com/panevx/gpanev): Responsive bilingual website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and published on GitHub Pages.
- [TikTok account relaunch](https://www.tiktok.com/@panevx): Relaunched a dormant account with street interviews, generating over 676,000 organic views in five days.

## Experience and activities

- [Invest Sofia](https://investsofia.com/): Interned at Sofia's municipal investment agency and returned in 2026 to support marketing. Took and uploaded photos for its digital communications.
- Erasmus+ STEM delegation (June 2026): Represented his school on an ICT and STEM exchange in Metković, Croatia.
- Intellectual property training (October 2025): Participated in training by EUIPO and the Bulgarian Patent Office.
